themes.title: Far-right parties exploit migration crises for political gain
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are leveraging migration crises to push anti-immigration policies and rally political support. This theme is evident in Italy, Spain, and Germany, where leaders like Meloni, Vox, and AfD are framing migration as a national security threat, often clashing with EU partners over border controls and asylum policies.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox demands stricter border controls and legal action against Spain's government over Ceuta migrant crisis, framing it as a national security failure.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government suspends Schengen rules with Spain over migration disputes, escalating tensions and using the crisis to bolster domestic support.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD capitalizes on migration fears in regional elections, advocating for stricter asylum policies and deportations.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Farage proposes using the Royal Navy to block Channel migrant crossings, echoing far-right anti-immigration rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Criticizes Norway's integration policies, calling for stricter immigration controls and alignment with Denmark's data-driven approach.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Le Pen and Bardella criticize Macron's migration policies, advocating for national sovereignty over EU asylum rules.

themes.title: Right-wing leaders rally behind restrictive birthright citizenship policies
themes.blurb: The U.S. and Hungary are leading a transnational push to restrict birthright citizenship, with Trump signing executive orders targeting 'birth tourism' and Hungary's Tisza party advocating for constitutional reforms. This theme reflects a broader right-wing effort to redefine citizenship and national identity along exclusionary lines.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump signs executive orders targeting birthright citizenship exceptions, facing legal challenges but reinforcing anti-immigration rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Tisza party debates constitutional reforms to restrict birthright citizenship, aligning with nationalist policies.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS proposes deporting draft-age Ukrainian men, linking migration to national security and demographic concerns.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates
themes.blurb: Argentina, Hungary, and the U.S. are witnessing right-wing governments cutting social programs under the guise of fiscal responsibility. Milei's austerity measures, Hungary's energy crisis management, and Trump's rollback of federal grants highlight a shared strategy of reducing state welfare to prioritize market-driven solutions.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei's government faces backlash for cutting social programs, including health coverage and education funding, to reduce fiscal deficits.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Tisza government reviews cancer screenings and energy subsidies, citing fiscal constraints and past mismanagement.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration cancels federal grants for teen pregnancy prevention programs, redirecting funds to conservative priorities.

themes.title: AfD surge reshapes German politics ahead of regional elections
themes.blurb: Germany's AfD is dominating regional election campaigns, particularly in Saxony-Anhalt and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, where it leads polls and threatens to govern alone. This surge is prompting mainstream parties to adopt harder stances on migration and EU policies, signaling a broader rightward shift in German politics.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD leads polls in Saxony-Anhalt and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, advocating for stricter migration controls and EU skepticism.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: SD's rise in Sweden mirrors AfD's success, with both parties pushing anti-immigration agendas and influencing mainstream politics.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Le Pen's RN capitalizes on migration fears, echoing AfD's rhetoric and positioning itself as a viable alternative to Macron.

themes.title: Right-wing leaders face internal divisions and leadership challenges
themes.blurb: Internal divisions are fracturing right-wing parties in Poland, Italy, and Argentina, with leaders like Morawiecki, Salvini, and Milei facing opposition from within their ranks. These splits reflect broader ideological conflicts over nationalism, economic policy, and party direction, threatening electoral cohesion.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS faces internal splits as Morawiecki forms a rival faction, challenging Kaczyński's leadership and party unity.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Salvini's Lega struggles with internal dissent over leadership and alliances, with factions pushing for a return to federalist roots.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei's government grapples with internal conflicts, particularly between Karina Milei and Vice President Villarruel, over policy direction.
